lines.t: I could hear the little things
The hum of the world
But never heard a father's voice
I could see the little things
The breeze in the trees
But never saw a father's face
He is the father I never had
He is the lover to my broken heart
And he is the father to my little child
He's holdin' me and teachin' me to love like him
